decisions.reason: After surviving the earlier range review, this publicly introduced carpet benefits from added commitment and a growing market, though as a close-to-core carpet in a crowded assortment it still remains somewhat disposable.
The corner bench sits squarely in the firm's core furniture business and its continued presence makes management more inclined to justify and support it rather than reverse course.
This carpet also gained from the firm's prior decision to retain it, but carpets are still easier to rationalize than core furniture if resources are shifted to newer development priorities.

The swivel shell chair line represents broader investment and visible commitment across several models while fitting flexible workplace concepts, so escalation of commitment strongly favors continuation.
